title: Alternatives To Ltree
summary: ltree extension-track lesson for recursive CTE adjacency lists, closure tables, and the narrow cases where ltree wins, with core-first posture and operational verification.
learning_objectives: Explain when ltree is justified by workload evidence.
Compare the extension behavior to the PostgreSQL core alternative.
State the operational cost, caveats, and verification path.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would justify this extension instead of a core-only design?
What would make not yet the more responsible recommendation?
